name: Path to Ascension: opening the Hero Architect and loading builds record the Hero Architect tutorials
contract: Building Your Class Fantasy (75) is for the Hero class (class mask 0x200), excludes game modes 0x848 and has two objectives: 'Hit N, then click the Hero Architect Tab.' and 'Choose a Featured Build and load it with "Choose This Build."'. Clicking the tab sends the category query CMSG 0x062E {category name}; loading a build sends CMSG 0x05C2 {id, u8, u8} and is answered with ACTIVATE_BUILD_OK on SMSG 0x05C3. The objectives are kept as event bits in core.ascension.tutorial_events index 75 (bit 1 the tab, bit 2 a featured build); the tutorial verifies once both are met. End Game Builds (7), any class, excludes 0x848 and reads 'Load a featured end-game build'. The seeded board has no featured build and a player cannot publish one, so loading the seeded Level 60 PvE build The Tankiest Bear (cac04950-5c76-4ae9-80ed-c81553578d08), an end-game build without the featured flag, completes neither the featured objective of 75 nor tutorial 7. A Hero whose featured objective is already recorded verifies 75 by opening the tab; a Warrior with the same record does not, as 75 is not for that class.
